SELECT e.avid AS episode_avid, e.title AS episode_title, e.episode_number, e.duration, v.avid AS video_avid, v.title AS video_title, v.cover_url AS video_cover, u.nike_name AS nick_name, u.avatar AS avatar_url, CONCAT('/client/video/', v.avid, '/episode/', e.avid) AS play_link, t.favorite_time, u.uid AS up_uid, u.nike_name AS up_nike_name, u.avatar AS up_avatar, u.descript AS up_descript, u.sex AS up_sex, u.is_vip AS up_is_vip, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_follow f WHERE f.user_id = u.id AND f.is_delete = 0) AS up_follow_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.user_follow f WHERE f.follow_user_id = u.id AND f.is_delete = 0) AS up_fans_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ue.like_count), 0) FROM public.video_info uv INNER JOIN public.video_episode ue ON ue.video_id = uv.id AND ue.is_delete = 0 WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.is_delete = 0) AS up_total_like_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ue.play_count), 0) FROM public.video_info uv INNER JOIN public.video_episode ue ON ue.video_id = uv.id AND ue.is_delete = 0 WHERE uv.user_id = u.id AND uv.is_delete = 0) AS up_total_play_count FROM ( SELECT ef.episode_id, MAX(ef.create_time) AS favorite_time FROM public.episode_favorite ef WHERE ef.user_id = #{userId} AND ef.status = 1
AND ef.folder_id = #{folderId}
GROUP BY ef.episode_id ) t INNER JOIN public.video_episode e ON e.id = t.episode_id AND e.is_delete = 0 INNER JOIN public.video_info v ON v.id = e.video_id AND v.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON u.id = v.user_id
(e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nike_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.uid LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.favorite_time DESC
